activity.notes: Commodus was elevated to Augustus and became co-ruler with Marcus Aurelius in 177. He remained co-emperor until Marcus Aurelius died on 17 March 180, when Commodus became sole emperor. ATLAS records this joint imperial phase separately from the existing 180-192 sole reign.

sources.title: Commodus, Lucius Aurelius, Roman emperor, 180–192 CE — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: The Oxford Classical Dictionary states that Commodus was Augustus and co-ruler in 177 and became sole emperor on the death of Marcus Aurelius on 17 March 180.
